scope.objective: Make FND-001 Landauer-gap accounting fail closed at the accepted-useful-task boundary.
scope.energy_denominator: total wall-plug joules for all attempts in the window divided by accepted outputs
scope.landauer_floor: independently accounted irreversible erased bits per accepted output multiplied by k_B*T*ln(2)
scope.ratio_interpretation: diagnostic only; wall-plug energy is not identical to Landauer heat and the ratio is not thermodynamic efficiency
scope.ratio_below_one: BOUNDARY_AUDIT_REQUIRED; not a declaration of a thermodynamic violation

lane_interfaces.A: Bind the same workload contract, output-quality gate, retries and competitive CPU/GPU/NPU baseline.
lane_interfaces.B: No provider calls; future records must preserve same-provider, target, calibration, price and billing provenance.
lane_interfaces.C: Output-information lower bounds remain distinct from irreversible erasure counts and readable memory/storage.
lane_interfaces.D: Require a same-evolution physical energy/temperature basis before device-level interpretation.
lane_interfaces.E: No Pangola, material, bio-oil, fusion-electricity or cooling evidence promotion.
lane_interfaces.F: Own accepted-task energy accounting, evidence label, uncertainty and full-system boundary.
lane_interfaces.G: No factory/device requirement is inferred until a target-specific device need exists; retain D/G co-design.
lane_interfaces.H: Mission and financing goals remain separate from measured energy/cost; no WACC or interest claim.

foundations.FND-001: Accounting interface advanced; measured thermodynamic gap remains open.
foundations.FND-002: Output-information lower bounds remain separate; no inference from output width.
foundations.FND-003: Matched evolution energy and scheduled duration remain required.
foundations.EQN-001_to_EQN-006: No equation promoted; established physical limits remain binding.

next_gate: Exact-head Python 3.10-3.12 and full repository CI, then a frozen workload with measured full-system energy, accepted-output count, temperature basis, uncertainty and independently justified erasure accounting.
